title: From Locking to Collective Chaos: A Reproducible, Mechanism-Based Review of Kaneko-Style Dynamical Systems
affil: Laboratory of Fluid Mechanics and Instabilities, École Polytechnique Fédérale de Lausanne, CH-1015 Lausanne, Switzerland
lede: We investigate whether this body of work can be reconstructed as a single mechanism-based atlas rather than a chronology, organised around six physical mechanisms that run from phase instability to mean-field coupling.
